description: Create a short-lived (30 min) link that a business opens to connect its WhatsApp number through Meta Embedded Signup (Coexistence supported). Your system should open the returned connect_url for the client, normally behind its own "Connect WhatsApp" button; use this tool to test that flow.

display_name.description: Business name shown on the page.

state.description: Your own client id; returned unchanged when the connection completes (popup postMessage, register-from-code response, GET /onboarding/events).

name: bridge_connect_link
title: Create a Connect WhatsApp link
